title: The Dog Night, 2016
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Seventeen years. The dumpster, then the box. The pup has learned the route.

panels.composition: The dumpster, bulb. WOOD. BARNABY II sitting at the fence without being told — he's learned it.

image.prompt: a man standing behind a bowling alley at night before a rusted dumpster under a bulb, a wiry three-legged dog sitting at the chain-link fence on its own, clean ink, no words

panels.composition: The pup's face. Two years old. One ear up. Looking at Wood, not the fence.

image.prompt: close-up of a wiry three-legged dog with one ear up looking at its owner instead of the fence, no words

panels.composition: The porch. The box. The pup in it. Wood on the step. The same as last year; the strip lets it be the same.

image.prompt: a three-legged dog sitting in a battered produce box on a porch at night, a man on the step beside it, no words

panels.composition: The sign, distant. Four letters dark now. Wood counting them, the reader can tell.

image.prompt: a man on a porch at night looking across rooftops at a distant bowling-alley sign with four letters gone dark, a dog in a box beside him, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk
